paper_identity.title: Generalized logistic growth modeling of the COVID-19 outbreak

final_report_expectations.research_question: The available PDF supports only a supplement-level question: how logistic growth, generalized Richards, and growth-rate decay fits summarize COVID-19 case trajectories across 29 mainland Chinese provinces.
final_report_expectations.study_design: Supplementary model-fitting material with one summary table and province-level figures; the main article narrative is not present in this fixture.
final_report_expectations.population_or_materials: COVID-19 confirmed-case data for 29 mainland Chinese provinces, explicitly excluding Hubei and Tibet, summarized through March 1, 2020 for figures and as of February 29, 2020 in Table S1.
methods: Summarize Table S1 fitted parameters/statistics only within supplement scope.
Identify logistic growth model and generalized Richards model fits to cumulative cases.
Describe daily new cases and daily growth-rate visualizations.
Describe robustness fits using generalized Richards model cutoffs 20, 15, 10, and 5 days before March 1, 2020.
Describe linear regressions/log-linear growth-rate fits without inventing main-paper methods.
primary_findings: The supplement reports fitted model statistics for 29 provinces.
Province figures pair empirical confirmed-case data with logistic and generalized Richards fitted curves.
Generalized Richards fits are shown with earlier cutoff dates to demonstrate consistency/robustness.
secondary_findings: Figures include cumulative confirmed cases, daily new confirmed cases, and daily growth rates.
Growth rates are shown both against time on log scale and against cumulative confirmed cases on linear scale.
Linear fits are separated for January 19 to February 1 and February 2 to March 1 periods.
sensitivity_analysis: Earlier-cutoff generalized Richards model fits use data ending 20, 15, 10, and 5 days before March 1, 2020.
No full-paper sensitivity analysis can be assessed because the fixture contains only supplementary material.
statistical_tests_used: Exponential decay exponent of growth rate.
Linear regression of logarithmic daily growth rate over time.
Linear fits of daily growth rate versus cumulative confirmed cases for two date intervals.
interpretation: Treat all claims as supplement-derived model-fitting evidence.
Do not infer epidemic-policy conclusions, full introduction, or discussion content from the absent main article.
limitations: Table S1 appears as a table/figure-like PDF element, so extracted numeric cells are not reliably available from text alone.
Scientific synthesis is limited to headings, descriptive supplement text, table title, and figure descriptions.
tables_figures_supplements: Supplementary Material page 1 describes all available content.
Table S1 summarizes statistics and fitted parameters for 29 provinces.
Subsequent province figures show cumulative cases, new cases, growth rates, and model fits.
final_report_expectations.supplement_availability: The local source is supplementary material; main article content is unavailable in this fixture.
uniqueness: It requires avoiding fabricated full-paper sections.
It emphasizes model-fit robustness cutoffs and province-level figure interpretation.
